title: エリザベス女王杯にむけて

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Finally, it is time for Mejiro Dober's race against Air Groove—a necessary battle in her journey to forge a new Mejiro legacy.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Dober asks if I still believe in her strength. I tell her that my faith in her has never changed since the day we met. With that, I see her off.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: There's no time to look away. This is the moment Mejiro Dober will transcend herself and forge a new Mejiro legacy!
